info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Caledoni Drill Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Caledoni Drill Detail Creation API allows users to efficiently input and manage details for Caledoni drill products within the catalog. This functionality is essential for businesses looking to maintain accurate and up-to-date information on their drilling equipment offerings. Typical consumers include product managers and catalog administrators who require a streamlined way to ensure product details are entered and stored correctly. This API supports the creation of detailed entries, enhancing the overall integrity of the catalog and facilitating better decision-making and resource management.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create detailed records for the Caledoni drill. It accepts the necessary details in the request body and returns the created record upon successful processing.

requestBody.description: Request body for creating or updating details of a Caledoni drill operation. The payload must conform to the specified JSON schema to ensure proper processing of the request.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested details.

CreateCatalogCaledoniDrillDetailRequest.title: Caledoni Drill Operations Request

caledoni_drill_id.description: The unique identifier for the Caledoni drill.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person or entity who requested the operation.

isPriority.description: Indicates if the operation has priority status.

unitPrice.description: The unit price associated with the operation.

tags.description: A list of tags associated with the operation for categorization purposes.

items.description: A tag used to categorize the operation.

CreateCatalogCaledoniDrillDetailRequest.description: Schema representing the request body for creating an operation related to the Caledoni drill.

CreateCatalogCaledoniDrillDetailResponse.title: Post Operation Response

status.description: The status of the operation, indicating success or failure.

recordId.description: The unique identifier of the record created or processed.

processedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the operation was processed.

matchedCount.description: Number of records that matched the criteria during the operation.

warnings.description: List of warnings generated during the operation, if any.

items.description: A warning message related to the operation.

CreateCatalogCaledoniDrillDetailResponse.description: Response schema for a successful POST operation regarding drilled details.
